title: Nashville, TN — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Nashville, TN: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Nashville is a city in TN with a population of 694,144. Music City with live music everywhere, no state income tax, and booming healthcare. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.4.
